newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes flat at 474/475 to dollar.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes flat at 474/475 to dollar.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat in quiet trade against the dollar at 474/475 in a session during which the Central Bank gently fed the market greenbacks, traders said.
"Dollar demand was normal with the interbank offering some. But their rates were too high, so the Central Bank supplied the bulk of the session's dollars," said one trader.
Traders said the bolivar could firm on Wednesday, when markets re-open after the two-day Carnival holiday, on foreign purchases of TEMs at the Central Bank's regular 60 billion bolivar auction.
